propositions.proposition: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
propositions.relevance: Links the pre-rebrand legal name Oakfield Logistics GmbH to the post-rebrand name Oakfield Logistik GmbH (billing:right) as the same registered entity.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that CRM still shows the old English-facing name after the rebrand to Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Preserves that CRM naming for the left referent may differ from the current billing legal name without asserting they are distinct entities.

propositions.proposition: CRM record OAK-77 lists the account name Oakfield Logistics with domain oakfield-log.com, country DE, contact M. Weber, and status active.
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the left referent crm:OAK-77 under an English-facing name that differs from the billing billed_name string.

propositions.proposition: Company registry entry HRB 88421 lists the legal name Oakfield Logistik GmbH in Germany with status active.
propositions.relevance: Provides the registered legal name matching billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH and tied in notes to the unchanged HRB 88421 across the rebrand.

propositions.proposition: Billing records use billed_name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the right referent billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH as the name appearing on billed invoices.
